hypothesis: Per-panel table in one big row group (1M rows): smaller groups hurt, so minimize row-group overhead.

queries.routes: SELECT dim_s AS dimension, flights, observed_arrivals, arrival_delay_minutes, delayed_flights, cancellations, diversions FROM cache WHERE kind = 'routes' AND Month = {{month}} AND Origin = {{origin}}
queries.carriers: SELECT dim_s AS dimension, flights, observed_arrivals, arrival_delay_minutes, delayed_flights, cancellations, diversions FROM cache WHERE kind = 'carriers' AND Month = {{month}} AND Origin = {{origin}}
queries.departure_hours: SELECT CAST(dim_s AS DOUBLE) AS dimension, flights, observed_arrivals, arrival_delay_minutes, delayed_flights, cancellations, diversions FROM cache WHERE kind = 'hours' AND Month = {{month}} AND Origin = {{origin}}
queries.weekdays: SELECT CAST(dim_s AS BIGINT) AS dimension, flights, observed_arrivals, arrival_delay_minutes, delayed_flights, cancellations, diversions FROM cache WHERE kind = 'weekdays' AND Month = {{month}} AND Origin = {{origin}}
queries.national_carriers: SELECT dim_s AS dimension, flights, observed_arrivals, arrival_delay_minutes, delayed_flights, cancellations, diversions FROM cache WHERE kind = 'national' AND Month = {{month}}

materialize.sql:
SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'routes' AS kind, Month, Origin AS Origin, CAST(Dest AS VARCHAR) AS dim_s, COUNT(*) AS flights, COUNT(ArrDelay) AS observed_arrivals, SUM(ArrDelay) AS arrival_delay_minutes,
 SUM(CASE WHEN ArrDelay >= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delayed_flights,
 SUM(CASE WHEN Cancelled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancellations,
 SUM(CASE WHEN Diverted = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diversions FROM data GROUP BY Month, Origin, Dest UNION ALL SELECT 'carriers' AS kind, Month, Origin AS Origin, CAST(UniqueCarrier AS VARCHAR) AS dim_s, COUNT(*) AS flights, COUNT(ArrDelay) AS observed_arrivals, SUM(ArrDelay) AS arrival_delay_minutes,
 SUM(CASE WHEN ArrDelay >= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delayed_flights,
 SUM(CASE WHEN Cancelled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancellations,
 SUM(CASE WHEN Diverted = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diversions FROM data GROUP BY Month, Origin, UniqueCarrier UNION ALL SELECT 'hours' AS kind, Month, Origin AS Origin, CAST(FLOOR(CRSDepTime / 100.0) AS VARCHAR) AS dim_s, COUNT(*) AS flights, COUNT(ArrDelay) AS observed_arrivals, SUM(ArrDelay) AS arrival_delay_minutes,
 SUM(CASE WHEN ArrDelay >= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delayed_flights,
 SUM(CASE WHEN Cancelled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancellations,
 SUM(CASE WHEN Diverted = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diversions FROM data GROUP BY Month, Origin, FLOOR(CRSDepTime / 100.0) UNION ALL SELECT 'weekdays' AS kind, Month, Origin AS Origin, CAST(DayOfWeek AS VARCHAR) AS dim_s, COUNT(*) AS flights, COUNT(ArrDelay) AS observed_arrivals, SUM(ArrDelay) AS arrival_delay_minutes,
 SUM(CASE WHEN ArrDelay >= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delayed_flights,
 SUM(CASE WHEN Cancelled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancellations,
 SUM(CASE WHEN Diverted = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diversions FROM data GROUP BY Month, Origin, DayOfWeek UNION ALL SELECT 'national' AS kind, Month, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS Origin, CAST(UniqueCarrier AS VARCHAR) AS dim_s, COUNT(*) AS flights, COUNT(ArrDelay) AS observed_arrivals, SUM(ArrDelay) AS arrival_delay_minutes,
 SUM(CASE WHEN ArrDelay >= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delayed_flights,
 SUM(CASE WHEN Cancelled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancellations,
 SUM(CASE WHEN Diverted = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diversions FROM data GROUP BY Month, UniqueCarrier) ORDER BY kind, Month, Origin
